Aura Mew: 2-26 agosto 2007 nel Regno Uni: Aura Mew: 2-26 August 2007 in the United Kingdom, 25-28 October 2007 in Norway, 5 November - 14 December 2007 in Sweden, 3-30 January 2008 in Denmark; 7-8 July 2007 in Italy, Toys "R" Us stores in the United Kingdom, events and mail distributions in the Nordic countries, Mirabilandia park in Italy; wireless distribution at the events, and by mail in the two Nordic countries where no event took place. Berry Program Update Zigzagoon, edizione: Berry Program Update Zigzagoon, Japanese edition with trainer Ruby: 29 December 2003 - 31 March 2004, Pokémon Centers in Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya and Fukuoka, and participating stores in Japan; GameCube connected to the Game Boy Advance with the cable, and the Monthly Nintendo Store Demo discs for January, February and March 2004. It is the gift that accompanied the correction of the faulty internal clock of the first Ruby and Sapphire cartridges, a fault that after a year stopped berries from growing. The trainer name, Ruby, is chosen at random between the two possibilities; since the seed comes from the sum of the digits of the hours, minutes and seconds of the clock, only 214 distinct Zigzagoon exist.

Berry Program Update Zigzagoon, English edition with trainer RUBY: 1 March 2004 - 22 April 2007, EB Games and GameStop stores, and a demo disc for the home console; wireless distribution in the stores, or from the demo disc at home. This specimen was not the gift but the vehicle: its function was to correct a fault in the internal clock of the first Ruby and Sapphire cartridges, which after a year stopped berries from growing. The trainer name was chosen between RUBY and SAPHIRE, and the second spelling lacks a letter because the name field accepts seven characters. The distribution lasted more than three years, the longest in the whole catalogue.

Berry Program Update Zigzagoon, English edition with trainer SAPHIRE: 1 March 2004 - 22 April 2007, EB Games and GameStop stores, and a demo disc for the home console; wireless distribution in the stores, or from the demo disc at home. Variant with the trainer name truncated to seven characters. See the RUBY trainer entry for the rest.
